correctness.rationale: The Tutte–Coxeter graph was independently reconstructed as the Levi incidence graph on 15 duads and 15 synthemes (30 vertices,45 edges, cubic, girth eight). Enumerated exactly 90 simple 8-cycles and 1125 vertex-disjoint unordered pairs. For the unordered two-particle Abrams deleted-product CW complex, independently enumerated 435 vertices,1260 edges,900 squares; checked integral cellular d1*d2=0 and all signed 64-square torus products are d2-cycles. S6 on six labels divides pairs into orbits (45,360,360,360) with bridge profiles (0,empty),(2,(2,4)),(2,(2,4)),(2,(3,3)), and mod-2 torus ranks (35,89,89,90). The distinguished 360-pair (3,3) orbit contains a deterministically selected 90x90 integer coordinate minor with exact determinant -1 (independent check); hence its 90 cycles span a primitive rank-90 sublattice L in Z^900. The separately recomputed mod-101 boundary rank is 810; 90 independent cycles force characteristic-zero rank <=810, so rank ker(d2)=90. Because ker(d2) is primitive in Z^900 and L primitive rank90, the inclusion L subset ker(d2) is equality, proving integral basis. Other individual orbits fail integral generation by their strict mod-2 rank deficiency. Rank modulo 101 is used only as a rational-rank bound, never as integral saturation proof.
residual_risks: Exact finite computation classifies this one fixed graph and its particular natural S6 subgroup, not the full graph automorphism representation or all cubic cages. Mod-2 rank deficits exclude integer generation, not necessarily rational generation.

evidence: An–Knudsen geometric generators apply to planar graph braid groups and document nonplanar exceptions; Tutte–Coxeter is nonplanar (30V,45E,girth8 => violates planar girth bound). General intersection-form and maturity theorems concern Betti data under hypotheses, not a distinguished S6 octagon orbit integral basis.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A more general planar theorem cannot dominate a result on this nonplanar graph. A general computational description of configuration-space homology does not already establish a particular four-orbit integral saturation result.
